tokens.name: p1-purple-900
tokens.usage: Deepest brand purple. Hero and footer grounds, dashboard sidebars. `fg-on-dark` (16.8:1) and `fg-on-dark-2` (12.2:1) read on it; `p1-orange-500` (8.5:1) for highlights.

tokens.name: p1-purple-800
tokens.usage: PRIMARY brand purple (#45166A). The "PRESS" in the wordmark, headlines on light grounds, navbars, secondary buttons, the selected pricing card. White text on it is 13.3:1.

tokens.name: p1-purple-600
tokens.usage: Mid purple. Links (`link`), decorative shapes, secondary accents. 5.6:1 on white: fine for text.

tokens.name: p1-purple-400
tokens.usage: Soft purple. Dividers and quiet text on `p1-purple-900` (5.9:1), dot accents. Not for text on white.

tokens.name: p1-purple-100
tokens.usage: Purple tint. `brand-soft` fills: icon tiles, ghost-button hover, highlighted rows.

tokens.name: p1-purple-50
tokens.usage: Page tint. Alternate section ground (`bg-tint`), testimonial and feature bands.

tokens.name: p1-orange-700
tokens.usage: Pressed/hover orange for the primary CTA (`accent-hover`). White text on it is 3.4:1: bold 19px+ only.

tokens.name: p1-orange-600
tokens.usage: PRIMARY brand orange (#FF8200). CTA fills, the "ONE" in the wordmark, key data points, link hover. White text on it is only 2.5:1 (a source pair kept as is): keep CTA labels bold, uppercase and large, and prefer `p1-purple-900` text (6.8:1) where legibility matters.

tokens.name: p1-orange-500
tokens.usage: Gold-orange. Highlights, eyebrows and emphasis on dark purple (8.5:1 on `p1-purple-900`), the lower rows of the dot-grid mark. Not for text on white.

tokens.name: p1-orange-200
tokens.usage: Orange tint. Text selection background, soft highlight fills.

tokens.name: p1-orange-50
tokens.usage: Soft orange wash (`accent-soft`). Icon hover tiles, callout grounds.

tokens.name: p1-ink-900
tokens.usage: Highest-contrast text (`fg1`): headings on `bg`, `bg-alt`, `bg-tint` (17.4:1 on white).

tokens.name: p1-ink-800
tokens.usage: Body text from the style guide (`fg2`). 12.1:1 on white, 11.1:1 on `bg-tint`.

tokens.name: p1-ink-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text (`fg3`): ledes, card body, captions. 6.8:1 on white, 6.3:1 on `bg-tint`.

tokens.name: p1-ink-400
tokens.usage: Muted (`fg4`, `border-strong`). Placeholder text, token labels, strong borders. Only 2.8:1 on white: never for body copy.

tokens.name: p1-ink-200
tokens.usage: Standard border (`border`) on inputs and dividers.

tokens.name: p1-ink-100
tokens.usage: Hairline (`hairline`) under the navbar, around cards and logo strips.

tokens.name: p1-ink-50
tokens.usage: Subtle grey surface (`bg-alt`), code chips, dashboard canvas.

tokens.name: p1-white
tokens.usage: Pure white. Default page and card surface.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Default page ground. Text: `fg1`–`fg3`.

tokens.name: bg-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate grey section ground.

tokens.name: bg-tint
tokens.usage: Purple-tinted section ground; alternate with `bg` down long pages.

tokens.name: bg-inverse
tokens.usage: Inverse ground (`p1-purple-800`) for dark bands. Text: `fg-on-dark`, `fg-on-dark-2`.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Card surface. Pair with a 1px `hairline` border and `shadow-sm`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: modals, popovers, chat panel.

tokens.name: fg1
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on `bg`, `bg-alt`, `bg-tint`, `surface-card` (17.4:1).

tokens.name: fg2
tokens.usage: Default body text on `bg`, `bg-tint`, `surface-card` (12.1:1).

tokens.name: fg3
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, descriptions, captions on `bg` and `bg-tint` (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: fg4
tokens.usage: Muted labels and placeholders only; 2.8:1 on `bg`, so never for reading text.

tokens.name: fg-on-dark
tokens.usage: Headlines and primary text on `p1-purple-800`/`p1-purple-900` (13.3:1+).

tokens.name: fg-on-dark-2
tokens.usage: Body text on `p1-purple-800` (9.6:1) and `p1-purple-900` (12.2:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary CTA fill, eyebrows, key figures. See `p1-orange-600` for the 2.5:1 white-label caveat.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary CTA hover/pressed fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Soft orange fill behind icons and callouts.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand purple for headlines, navbar text, secondary buttons and ghost-button outlines.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for `brand` buttons.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Purple tint fill: icon tiles, ghost hover, selected rows.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on `bg` (5.6:1) and `bg-tint` (5.2:1), underlined 1.5px.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover color. Keep the underline: this orange is 2.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring at 2px offset. Reads on dark purple (9.5:1 on `p1-purple-900`) but only 1.8:1 on white: flagged; on light grounds add a `brand` inner ring.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state, positive sentiment, checklist ticks. 4.1:1 on white: bold or 18px+ text, or pair with an icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning state. 2.3:1 on white: icons and fills only, never text on white.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive actions, end-call button. 5.3:1 on white.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Standard 1px border on inputs and dividers.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Strong border for emphasised outlines and input hover.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px hairline on cards, navbar bottom edge, logo strips.

color.note: Two brand hues plus neutrals, locked by the PressONE Website Style Guide. Raw ramps (`p1-*`) first, then semantic aliases. Use the semantic names in UI.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy in Instrument Sans, `fg2` on `bg`. From `body` in colors_and_type.css.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page headline in Instrument Serif 400. Emphasise with italic, never bold. From `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6` · `h1, .h1` in colors_and_type.css; also `.h1`.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headline in Instrument Serif 400. From `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6` · `h2, .h2` in colors_and_type.css; also `.h2`.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Card and block titles in Instrument Sans 600. From `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6` · `h3, .h3` in colors_and_type.css; also `.h3`.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Sub-block titles. From `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6` · `h4, .h4` in colors_and_type.css; also `.h4`.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Uppercase small heading, tracked `tracking-wide`. From `h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6` · `h5, .h5` in colors_and_type.css — uppercase; also `.h5`.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Fine print and captions, `fg3`. From `small, .small` in colors_and_type.css; also `.small`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code on a `p1-ink-50` chip in `p1-purple-800`. From `code, kbd, samp` in colors_and_type.css.

styles.name: kbd
styles.usage: Keyboard keys, same treatment as code. From `code, kbd, samp` in colors_and_type.css.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Display headline in Instrument Serif; 28px minimum. From `.display` in colors_and_type.css.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow over headlines, in `accent`. From `.eyebrow` in colors_and_type.css — uppercase.

styles.name: lede
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, `fg3`. From `.lede` in colors_and_type.css.

styles.name: hero-display
styles.usage: Hero headline in Instrument Serif at `fs-80`, from `.hero` in colors_and_type.css. Italic `em` for emphasis.
